requirements.operator_effect: Requires a versioned product-attribute comparison domain predicate and structured comparison trace.
requirements.extraction_effect: Requires structured, source-associated attribute records rather than unrelated flat colour/type arrays.
requirements.persistence_effect: Requires an additive structured-fact payload version; historical v3 payloads remain untouched.

truth_contract.TRUE: At least one complete approved comparison route materially matches.
truth_contract.FALSE: Complete comparable applicable attributes materially mismatch.
truth_contract.UNKNOWN: No route has both comparable operands, or routes conflict.

requirements.escalation_reason: No approved product-attribute materiality rules exist, and the current flat fact model cannot retain safe operand association.

requirements.operator_effect: Representable with existing ALL_OF, ANY_OF, FACT_IS_FOUND and FACT_EQUALS operators.
requirements.extraction_effect: Adds two source-qualified evidence facts. Missing search evidence remains NOT_FOUND and therefore UNKNOWN.
requirements.persistence_effect: Compatible with the existing flat fact payload.

truth_contract.TRUE: Either independent source branch is complete.
truth_contract.FALSE: Complete records positively disprove both branches.
truth_contract.UNKNOWN: Neither branch is complete; absence of a request record is never inverted.

requirements.approval_needed: Approve the exact scoped-search fact definitions.

required_facts_and_types: Attendance status for the same reservation
requirements.operator_effect: Requires an explicit cancellation-after-policy-cutoff domain predicate with a deterministic trace.
requirements.extraction_effect: Requires booking, cancellation and policy-window association; independent parallel arrays are prohibited.
requirements.persistence_effect: Requires an additive structured booking-event payload or an equally explicit associated record.

truth_contract.TRUE: No-show is established or the complete cutoff comparison proves late cancellation.
truth_contract.FALSE: Attendance or timely cancellation is established.
truth_contract.UNKNOWN: Neither branch has complete associated operands, or sources conflict.

requirements.escalation_reason: The current date-only flat facts and predicate language cannot safely calculate or associate the cutoff.

required_facts_and_types: Authoritative processor or merchant processing classification
requirements.required_logic: EXCEPTION_PROVEN; otherwise use the approved liability outcome
requirements.operator_effect: Requires a policy-specific recommendation mapping condition rather than aggregate-only mapping.
requirements.extraction_effect: Requires source-qualified authoritative classification on both sides.
requirements.persistence_effect: Requires an additive recommendation-mapping schema version; historical mappings remain untouched.

truth_contract.TRUE: Authoritative classifications deterministically prove issuer miscoding.
truth_contract.FALSE: Complete classifications agree that the code applies.
truth_contract.UNKNOWN: One side is absent or classifications conflict.

requirements.escalation_reason: The exact advisory vocabulary remains unapproved: RECOMMEND_DO_NOT_REPRESENT versus ACCEPT_LIABILITY.

requirements.operator_effect: Uses the existing versioned material-address operator with mismatch_result UNKNOWN for attribution uncertainty.
requirements.extraction_effect: No new provider contract is required.

truth_contract.TRUE: At least one comparable authorized address materially matches.
truth_contract.FALSE: Complete comparable records mismatch every authorized address.
truth_contract.UNKNOWN: Inputs are missing, non-comparable or attribution conflicts.

requirements.implementation_note: Do not ship this correction alone under a partially corrected v4-demo catalogue.

required_approvals: Approve the minimum structured product-attribute and booking-event fact expansion.
Choose the Visa 10.5 advisory outcome vocabulary.
Approve a policy-specific recommendation-mapping schema extension.
operational_consequence: The application and UI may demonstrate the preserved take-home-v3 pipeline with an explicit known-policy-limitations label, but the system must not claim corrected all-case policy fidelity or create take-home-v4-demo until these gates are resolved.
